source_page_content:
Westhaven Microscopy Suite

The Suite provides imaging services to members of Westhaven Research Cooperative and to outside investigators whose projects are accepted by the facility. Cooperative members must have a current project account and complete the Suite's user registration before using the facility. Outside investigators must submit a project intake form and obtain written approval from the facility director. An outside group may not enter the Suite or operate equipment until its billing contact and project account are on file.

Scheduling

Users schedule sessions by emailing the facility coordinator with the instrument, requested date, estimated duration, and sample type. Requests require at least five business days' notice. Routine sessions may be requested up to 45 days ahead. A reservation cancelled less than 24 hours before its start is charged for the first scheduled hour. Each user may hold one active reservation at a time, and routine sessions are limited to two hours. The facility director may authorize longer sessions for approved time-course studies.

Charges

Cooperative members pay $55 per hour for use of the widefield fluorescence microscope after passing the Suite's independent-use check. A staff-operated widefield session costs $90 per hour. Approved outside investigators pay $125 per hour for independent widefield use and $175 per hour for staff-operated use. Image analysis by Suite staff is billed at $60 per hour for all user groups. Charges are calculated in 30-minute increments. A 20% reduction on staff-operated imaging is available to cooperative members whose project account is supported by the Cooperative's shared-instrument grant. No other discounts or fee waivers are stated.

Instrument conditions

The widefield fluorescence microscope may be operated independently only by registered users who have completed the Suite's two-part training and passed the independent-use check. All other sessions must be operated by Suite staff. Fixed samples must be sealed on slides or in approved dishes. Live-cell samples require staff operation and prior confirmation of environmental-chamber availability. Users may not bring samples containing radioactive material into the Suite.

Entry and conduct

Access is available from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. on weekdays. Weekend access is not available. Users must sign the instrument log at the start and end of each session and remove their samples and materials when the session ends. A non-registered collaborator may enter only when accompanied by a registered user and may not operate an instrument.

These policies take effect September 15, 2024.
